facts: Native runner reports 63 passed and 1 failed; failure is missing server three-way-comparison heading after explicit recovery click at assessments.spec.ts:195.
Final error-context shows assisted needs_review attempt, real grade1, server answer still baseline, original local candidate preserved, and needsRecovery UI visible.
useAssessmentAttempt.restore sets claimed true; only initial/identity effect explicitly sets it false. Dependency is workspace plus JSON.stringify(target).
Shell key is active.id; unknown policy only hides non-assessment content; assisted assessment is not removed simply because policy.known becomes false.
Grading completed callback triggers session.retry; retry/reconcile never clears claimed. GET session/result do not increment API access generation.
bounded_conclusion: The artifacts show a lost UI recovery selection, not lost durable draft or a server write. They do not record mounts/epochs or prove grading-policy remount as the cause. Need frontend instrumentation of hook setup/cleanup and exact target/workspace/key around the click. JSON.stringify target field-order sensitivity is a candidate only, not a reproduced cause.
suggested_observations: Record monotonic hook instance/epoch and setup/cleanup reason with explicit scalar workspace/attempt/full-ref key.
Record only synthetic target identity order before and after Workbench save acknowledgement, plus claimed/conflict transitions; do not log answers or credentials.
Distinguish click handler entered/restore decision from post-click remount and grader callback reconcile.
limits: No new native or controlled React probe run here.
Source conclusions apply to exact source hashes listed, not any in-progress frontend fix.
